name: Heretic's Fervor

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: Alloy Casing
perks.desc:
Reduces weight for faster reloads.
  •  Greatly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: Black Powder
perks.desc:
This weapon's explosives are more effective.
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Impact Casing
perks.desc:
Increased damage on direct hits.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Tracking Module
perks.desc: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.desc: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.desc: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Bipod
perks.desc: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.desc: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.

perks.name: Dark Ether Reaper
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon periodically spawn Dark Ether charges.

Charges can be detonated early with weapons fire or by coming into contact with them. Doing so refills this weapon from reserves.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 127 from 21 January 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/27QaoJnY0M7c7Ikhz8CbUv?si=397188c406294fcf) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for burst damage against Majors sustained Boss damage in general, and end-game underleveled content. First thing to say is, if you already have a good DPS rocket launcher you can pass, even though aggressive frame rocket launchers are in the highest damage-per-shot category, as the ammo reserves are very low. At base, the other stats are decent - 68 Velocity equates to 37.84m/s, 20 Handling is 0.58s ready, 0.49 ADS and 0.48 stow speed, and 54 Reload Speed is a 3.03s per reload. With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo count is 8/9/10/10 (max 11). If you do want to save a roll, standard practice is to boosts Velocity and/or handling with the barrel perk, and use Impact Casing as the magazine perk to boost damage a bit by ×1.022. In the first trait perk slot, Field Prep helps with reload when crouched, and maxes our total ammo at 11 with two reserves mods (only one when enhanced), or Auto-Loading Holster to reload in the background. In the second, Explosive Light boosts damage by ×1.25 for up to 6 shots (7 when enhanced). The Dark Ether Reaper origin trait is one of the best in the sandbox for PvE, although less useful for boss DPS weapons. It generates a Dark Ether charge for 5s from kills, and then shoot with any weapon (or run into) the charge to proc a Dragonfly-type detonation which also overflows equipped and stowed Dark Ether weapons to ×1.4 (rounded up) base capacity or ×1.8 when enhanced, completely bypassing reload. So if you have a second Dark Ether weapon, that does mean that you can start a damage phase with 2 rockets loaded. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Quick Access Sling mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Did we need another generic rocket launcher? No, did we get one? Kinda. Rimestealer and Chill Clip immediately brings something more compared to other Stasis rockets but is it enough? Do you use rockets for add clear? No? Neither do I. It's a novelty but I'd rather use tried and true perks like Field Prep or Auto-Loading Holster coupled with Explosive Light for quick bursts of damage." Recommended MW: Blast Radius.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Yeah you see that right. QuickDraw in both column 3 and 4. Double Quickdraw. Super fast. Outside of that weirdness, go for Tracking Module for better chances to hit your intended target, Chill Clip to slow any stragglers or Explosive Light to really up your damage. Double Quickdraw." Recommended MW: Blast Radius.
